name: g6-selftest
purpose: Proves the sql-seed / sql-assert / sql-cleanup mechanics (prefix scoping, postcondition, cleanup-to-zero) without touching any business table.

scenario.title: G6 framework self-test
scenario.description: Seeds two rows into a session-local #temp table with the run prefix, asserts the count via SQL, deletes them and verifies Remaining = 0. No UI interaction beyond app startup.

testData.note: prefix and runId are injected by the runner

steps.description: SQL postcondition: exactly 2 seeded rows exist
Delete seeded rows and verify none remain
